Ads will launch in Apple Maps in the United States and Canada at some point this summer. In preparation for the launch, Apple has shared more details about the restrictions for Apple Maps ads.

Apple announces prohibited categories as Maps ads are about to arrive

Apple first announced its plans to introduce ads in Apple Maps back in March this year. The company said that ads would appear at the top of search results, as well as in a new "Suggested Places" widget.

In May, Apple laid the groundwork for the feature via iOS 26.5, which included the new "Suggested Places" function. However, the company has not provided any further updates on the actual launch date of Apple Maps ads since then.

According to TechCrunch, Apple recently published an updated version of its "Apple Advertising Services" policy, providing new information about Apple Maps.

The policy covers advertising details across multiple services including Apple News, Stocks, and Maps. It includes a list of prohibited ad content that applies across all services, covering items such as violence, weapons, and drugs.

However, what's most noteworthy are the additional details about Apple Maps ads. Apple says there are three additional categories prohibited in Apple Maps ads:

  • Home services: Any ad content that directly or indirectly promotes home services is prohibited, including but not limited to plumbing, locksmiths, HVAC, pest control, roofing, or general contracting services.
  • Bail bonds: Any ad content that directly or indirectly promotes bail bond services or surety bond services involving criminal pre-trial detention is prohibited.
  • Cryptocurrency ATMs: Any ad content that directly or indirectly promotes cryptocurrency ATMs is prohibited.

In addition, Apple said that ads involving medical services will be evaluated on a "case-by-case" basis.

As TechCrunch pointed out, Apple's complete ban on the "home services" category is rather interesting. This category is one of the major ad categories in Google Maps, but Apple appears to have no interest in introducing it to Apple Maps at all.

All of the above suggests Apple is on the verge of launching Apple Maps ads. However, as of now, there is still no officially announced launch date.

You can visit Apple's official website to browse the complete list of prohibited ad categories across all Apple services.
